analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI is consolidating around the 60-level, showing a lack of directional momentum. MACD histogram shows improvement but not yet at a level to confirm a trend reversal. Price action is consolidating within the 5-day high/low range, with no clear pattern formation. Trading volume is also at an average level, lacking strong conviction for either buying or selling pressure.
